title: CR-BRK-024 — Financial Data Confirmation Modal — Cancel path
preconds: See Financial \u2717 → enable a Part Sales or Invoicing checkbox → modal appears → Cancel (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Trigger the modal by checking Part Sales/Invoicing while See Financial OFF; click Cancel.
expected:
Cancel reverts the checkbox to its previous state; See Financial stays OFF; the Part Sales/Invoicing checkbox is unchecked (Financial Data Confirmation Modal).

Risk / Rationale: Cancel leaves the checkbox checked, or turns See Financial ON anyway.
Spec Ref: Financial Data Confirmation Modal
